en: Oh...good morning, Shuichi.

Good morning, Tsumugi.
Are you headed to the dining hall?

Yeah...well, not because anyone told me
to or anything. I just felt like it...
Oh, that reminds me...

Have you gone to the casino, Shuichi?
I find myself there sometimes...

I've never seen most of the games 
they have there.
Do you think Monokuma made them...?

If so, I regret getting hooked on one 
of them...
You're hooked on one, huh?

I'm just plain confident in my gaming skills.
Would you like to play together sometime?

Ah, sure...
If we get the chance...

Oh, sorry. We should stop talking about stuff
like this and go to the dining hall already.
I'm gonna go on ahead.

Hey, Shuichi... I mean, Poo-ichi!
There's somethin' I gotta ask you!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Why did she correct herself?
You ever hear about back items in casinos?
Back items? What are those?

Heeeeee... You wanna know more?
You do, right?
Then bow down to me, worm!
...Where is this coming from?

Last time, when you and Kaede bowed to me, it
felt so good that I had to put on dry panties!

So do it again! C'mon, c'mon, hurry up!
Make with the bowin' already!

Sorry, I'm not gonna do that.
See you later.
Huh!? W-Wait a minute!

Y-You don't need to bow!
Just listen to what I gotta say...
<CLT=cltMIND>She just wants my attention...

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I do kind of want to know what she's
talking about. I suppose I'll listen to her.

Alright, I'll hear you out.
What is a "back item"?

S-So, if you have a certain item, you can play
a back game sponsored by Monokuma himself...

It can be traded at a higher rate...and if you
do well, you can earn quite the fortune...

<CLT=cltMIND>A "back game"?
I have a bad feeling about this...

Ah, wait a minute.
Is that item...

this medal? It commemorates the
founding of the casino, after all.
Wh-What the—!?

You've made a discovery that even I, the
gorgeous girl genius Miu Iruma, couldn't find...

How could I be bested by the beta of all
betas!?
...*You* came to *me*.

I knew comin' to you was a good idea, what
with you bein' a detective and all...

You managed to track down that medal/coin
like I knew you would! Hah! I'm so awesome!
Let's bring that medal/coin to that casino!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to go with Miu Iruma?
No thank you.
Heeee!? Wh-Why!?

Any game sponsored by Monokuma
has to be dangerous.

Huhhhhh!?
Well, fuck you, too!
Stay a virgin forever for all I fuckin' care!

<CLT=cltMIND>Fine by me... This back game sounds
like another one of Monokuma's traps.

I'm a bit worried about Monokuma...but I'm more
worried about what will happen if we ignore it.
I'll see what happens, just in case.
Hah-hahaha! Just as I predicted!

Detectives get excited for casino games just
like boys get excited for holes!

Come to the casino once you're done eating!
And don't forget to bring that medal!
Ah, got it...

Hah hah hah!
Welp, I guess I'll finish eating!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm hesitant, but I don't want to ignore
it if it has the potential to be a problem.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's okay, right?

I have no interest in gambling...and I don't
know about any item like that.

I-I see...
Sorry I said anything...
<CLT=cltMIND>...There she goes.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's surprisingly normal when she gets turned
down. She should act like that all the time...

<CLT=cltMIND>But then again...I suppose
that's odd as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?

<CLT=cltMIND>That door I can see over there must
lead somewhere into the school...
<CLT=cltMIND>Where could it lead?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Closed)
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Open)
